editorial.blurb: Birndo is a beloved Ethiopian restaurant in the DMV known for bold, flavorful dishes and an elegant dining room that punches above its casual exterior.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or expect a wait—the restaurant prioritizes seating based on familiarity, so go with patience or ask to be added to a priority list if you're a regular.

topDishes.note: A table favorite; reviewers consistently praise it as delicious
Very delicious and memorable to diners
